name: Winter Café
source:
This game is about a cozy winter café where people of different backgrounds meet. 

[From [url=https://morgis.itch.io/winter-caf]Itch.io[/url]]

Made for Winter Visual Novel Jam 2022.
translation:
这款游戏讲述的是一家舒适的冬季咖啡馆，不同背景的人们在此相遇。

[来自[url=https://morgis.itch.io/winter-caf]Itch.io[/url]]

专为2022年冬季视觉小说Jam制作。
